spec.moment: Sitting on the sunny park hill with my sister, splitting a burrito while Biscuit guards his tennis ball and frisbee players drift across the slope.

elements.name: Biscuit
elements.look: a scruffy tan terrier-mix dog, ears perked, a slightly chewed yellow tennis ball held proudly in his mouth

elements.name: the burrito
elements.look: a fat foil-wrapped burrito split open in the middle, halves resting on a paper wrapper

elements.name: my sister
elements.look: a small simple figure in a red sweater sitting cross-legged on the grass

elements.name: the sunny park hill
elements.look: a rounded grassy hill with palm trees along the back edge and a strip of city rooftops beyond them

elements.name: frisbee players
elements.look: two tiny figures in blue and yellow shirts at the back edge of the hill, one arm raised toward a small white disc

elements.name: the tennis ball
elements.look: a bright yellow-green tennis ball, scuffed and slightly wet with dog slobber

spec.scene: A rounded grassy hill fills a small patch of ground, palm trees and a low strip of pale city rooftops at the back edge. At the center a scruffy tan dog sits with a yellow tennis ball in his mouth, a fat split burrito on paper beside him. A small figure in a red sweater sits cross-legged on the grass at the right, and two tiny figures in blue and yellow toss a white disc at the back edge. Morning light warms the grass, wind-bent blades leaning across the slope.
spec.title: Biscuit on the Park Hill
spec.caption: Biscuit found a tennis ball and we split a burrito in the sun. Perfect lazy Sunday.
